_comment: Signals used by the offline ExpenseClassifier. Each signal is matched case-insensitively against merchant, document type, line items and receipt text. Weights are summed per category; the best category wins and its share of the total score drives confidence.

AIR_TRAVEL.reason: the document is an airline invoice with a PNR, flight number and sector

TRAIN_TRAVEL.reason: the document is a rail ticket with train and coach details

TAXI.reason: the receipt is from a ride-hailing service and shows pickup and drop locations

HOTEL.reason: the invoice is issued by a hotel and contains room-night charges

MEALS.reason: the receipt is from a restaurant or café and lists food and beverage items

FUEL.reason: the receipt is from a fuel station and lists litres dispensed

PARKING.reason: the slip is a parking ticket with vehicle entry details

TOLL.reason: the receipt is from a toll plaza

MOBILE_INTERNET.reason: the document is a telecom bill with a billing period and plan charges

OFFICE_SUPPLIES.reason: the invoice is from a stationery/electronics retailer for work equipment

TRAINING_CONFERENCE.reason: the invoice is a conference or training registration

SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION.reason: the invoice is for a software licence or subscription

LOCAL_TRANSPORT.reason: the ticket is for local public transport
